release_notes:
Star Soft Enterprise v4.0.69 Release Notes (19-Nov-2026 02:30 PM):
- Fixed extra/unconfigured company text appearing on Browser Web Client (v1.8.3) bill printouts by removing the hardcoded Anna Salai fallback header, adding an opt-in 'Include Custom Header Text in Bill Print' condition in Company Profile Master (default OFF), and hiding GSTIN on Non-GST retail printouts.
- Added live Mobile No (Auto-DB Match) dropdown popup across all Desktop Billing screens (GST, Non-GST, Estimations, Dealer/Super Dealer & Kiosk) showing Customer Name, Place/Tier & Balance Due badge with Up/Down/Enter/Click instant fill.
- Upgraded Desktop Billing inputs & buttons with Web-style rounded capsules, focus blue rings, crisp mini vector icons (Phone, User, Address, Search) and native cue placeholders while strictly preserving DisplayResolutionService scaling across all screen resolutions.
